title: Mall River
content: I often have a reoccurring dream where I’m walking through a busy, well-lit mall with an archway of windows above. Then, part of the white tile walkway suddenly becomes a narrow, shallow river with some easy rapids, and people are kayaking and rafting down it. I always somehow end up in the river, holding on to the side of a raft, kicking along the river bottom (the water only comes up to my chest) while looking up at the shops and people as I float by. It isn’t stressful at all, and the mall-river-hallway seems to go on forever. I usually exit the river by climbing up a steep, muddy bank where the mall has transitioned into a travel center like an airport, with escalators and elevators all around, and a massive, vaulted ceiling and multilevel food court. I always feel out of place because I’m wet and muddy from being in the mall-river, but I start walking in the direction of what “I know” is a huge parking garage attached to a hotel or apartment where “I live”. Curious to know if anyone has experienced something similar. I’ve always had vivid dreams, and countless lucid ones. Dreams of specific and memorable locations are so intriguing. Some of the posts I’ve read here have deeply resonated with me.
